author: Mark Atwood
text: Deferring out of the JMAP-ayoz review-loop frontier. This crosses two crates: a public-API break to jmap-metadata-types (replacing the QueryObject::Comparator = serde_json::Value type alias with a typed MetadataComparator), and a corresponding handler shim change in jmap-metadata-server. The bead itself recommends 'Bundle into a metadata-types child bead AND a metadata-server child bead. Block on the metadata-types fix.' That decomposition can land as a dedicated cross-crate sub-epic in a future session. The crate is pre-1.0 so the public-API break is acceptable; the timing is the concern.
